content:
[L] high | top-left header | "Incidents" title and "Track outages..." subtitle are clipped by the window edge, cutting off the tops of the text
[L] high | filter row left edge | "Status:" label is cut off at the window's left boundary ("tatus:"), showing the filter bar starts at x=0 with zero inset
[L] high | bottom ~65% of window | entire region below the table is a black dead void — the app content pane doesn't fill the window
[L] high | status badges column | status chips ("investigating", "identified", "monitoring") are plain colored text with no visible badge background, reading as bare metadata unlike the sev chips which do have pill backgrounds — inconsistent chip treatment
[S] high | filter row | inconsistent element spacing: dropdowns, checkbox "Open only", and search field are jammed together with uneven gaps and no consistent grid
[S] med | table columns | "Open" action buttons float far right with a huge empty gap after CONVERSATIONS column; row content is spread with dead whitespace between title/severity/status columns
[S] med | header area | "3 incidents" count and "New Incident" button sit flush against the top-right corner with no margin, while left side is clipped — asymmetric edge treatment
[S] med | severity column | "sev1"/"sev2" have pill backgrounds but "sev3" is plain text — same data type rendered three different ways across three rows
[H] med | whole table | column headers are ALL-CAPS small gray text at near-body weight, giving no clear hierarchy; severity/status badges use similar size and compete with the title text
[H] med | title column | incident titles are plain body-weight text with no emphasis, so CODE, TITLE, and metadata all read at equal visual weight
[H] low | filter labels | "Status:"/"Severity:" inline labels are small and gray, weakly paired with their controls
[C] high | full window | layout is unbalanced: ~65% of the viewport is empty black while all content is crushed into the top third — reads as an unfinished debug render
[C] med | table bottom | no pagination/footer or summary row; table just ends abruptly at the black void with no visual closure
[C] low | filter row | "Apply" button is isolated at far right, far from the filter controls it applies to, requiring a full-width eye scan

VERDICT: unprofessional — clipped header text, a black void consuming two-thirds of the window, and inconsistent badge rendering make this read as an unfinished prototype, not shippable product.

Note: the three data rows themselves are internally legible.
